## About
The Brickyard Pub sits on Wilcox Ave in Hollywood, a short walk from Hollywood Blvd. Up front it's beers from around the world. In the back there's an upscale pool room. It's not your average dive bar.
Come for happy hour, stay for pool, shuffleboard or steel tip darts. Grab a spot on the balcony if it gets loud inside, or step out to the smoking patio.
Folks seem to like it here: we're rated 4.5 from 382 Google reviews.

## Services
- Happy Hour: Happy hour every day at the Hollywood bar.
- Billiards: 8 Championship style pool tables in the upscale pool room in the back.
- Shuffleboard: Two full size table top shuffleboards on custom lit tables. Grab your friends.
- Steel Tip Darts: One of the only bars around with steel tip darts. Battle your friends to see who's the champion.
- Beers: Over 150+ beers from around the world, from IPAs and hazies to Belgian whites and fruit beers.
- Book a Party: Reserve a free table for your group's home base.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open every day, 7:00 PM to 2:00 AM.

Q: Do I need to book for a small group?
A: If you have 14 or less people, just show up. Bigger groups can use the Book a Party form and we'll help reserve a sitting table.

Q: Can I reserve a pool table?
A: No. We don't reserve any of our pool tables or games. It gets busy later in the night, so come early if you want a table.

Q: How fast will I hear back about a party booking?
A: Within 24 hours, sometimes longer over weekends and holidays. If you don't see a confirmation, check your spam folder.

Q: Do you have beer on tap?
A: One reviewer noted that drinks are only served bottled.

## What customers say
- "They have happy hour from 7–9pm. Parking was a bit difficult to find, and there was a waitlist for both pool and darts when we arrived. We played darts for about 30 minutes while waiting for our pool table. The atmosphere was really fun overall, and they even have a photo booth inside. One thing to note is that drinks are only served bottled." (Aelita, 5/5)
- "Fun vibe, great bartenders, really awesome “checkpoint” for a night out. One few redeemable joints off Hollywood Blvd (let’s be real), and it’s always a blast. Cheapest pool hall you’ll find, but it gets busy as the night goes on and may be a long wait for a table, but they have darts & a smoking patio!" (feldy, 5/5)
- "Great place to play some pool! They have a happy hour special from 7 pm- 9 pm where you buy 2 beers and get the 3rd for free. Pool tables run $5 hr during Happy Hour and $10 hr after that. The atmosphere was laid back and I didn't wait long to get a table." (Joe Esquivel, 5/5)
- "I’ve come here with friends many times, but this is the second occasion on which their busser has thrown away bottles that still contained liquid. We lodged a complaint at the bar, and they replaced our beer; however, a few minutes later, the busser returned to clear our bottles again, and then he asked: "Should I take these, or do you want another free beer?" Is he pulling my leg?! My boyfriend and I were just about to leave, but Camila was very kind in trying to ensure that we didn't feel uncomfortable and in helping to make our evening enjoyable again. They definitely need to replace their busser, as this isn't the first time he has done something like this." (Sheila Ureta, 4/5)
- "Vibes were sick. Bartenders and bouncer were super cool. They have a balcony which is great if its a little too loud inside. Plenty of pool tables at like $16/hr. Decent parking, you can definitely find street parking too" (General trash, 4/5)
